_meta.title: Overlay composite (RGBA stickers / animated layers over a clip)
_meta.description: Pure compositing, no models: core nodes and VideoHelperSuite only. VHS_LoadVideo reads the source clip at 24 fps, sized to fit 1280 px (both sides a multiple of 8) and capped to the composited span. The builder (src/lib/oj/overlayComposite.ts) adds one chain per overlay: LoadImage (PNG/WebP) or VHS_LoadVideoFFmpeg (WebM/MOV with alpha, looped) -> JoinImageWithAlpha (RGBA) -> ImageScale -> ImageCrop when the overlay runs off the frame -> SplitImageWithAlpha + InvertMask (true alpha) -> SolidMask/MaskComposite multiply for opacity -> VHS_SplitImages for the start/end window -> ImageCompositeMasked (normal) or ImageCrop + ImageBlend (multiply/screen/overlay/soft_light/difference) then ImageCompositeMasked -> ImageBatch to rejoin the untouched frames. Layers stack in order. VHS_VideoCombine writes h264 mp4 with the source audio (silent clips are fine).
